headline_numbers: RHR −3.4 bpm (half-year) · HRV +1.7 ms/mo · debt still ~2.1 h/night — fitness↑ recovery stuck

min_hr_trends.note: Resting HR = Garmin RHR (best daily min/resting proxy). Weekly = raw week mean (not smoothed). 28d/90d = SMA. Yearly = full window start→end.

hrv_vs_rhr.label: HRV ↔ RHR
hrv_vs_rhr.explain: Negative = healthier pairing (high HRV with low RHR).

sleep_vs_score.label: Sleep hours ↔ score
sleep_vs_score.explain: How much duration still drives your score.

stress_vs_next_hrv.label: Stress → next HRV
stress_vs_next_hrv.explain: Does today’s stress predict tomorrow’s HRV?

intensity_vs_next_debt.label: Intensity → next debt
intensity_vs_next_debt.explain: Does hard load increase next-night shortfall?

train_vs_next_sleep.label: Train min → next sleep
train_vs_next_sleep.explain: Training minutes vs next night duration.

evening_hard_vs_next_sleep.label: Evening hard → next sleep
evening_hard_vs_next_sleep.explain: Evening Capoeira/hard session effect on next sleep.

explanations.title: Rolling correlation (trend, not one number)
explanations.text: r is recomputed every day on the last 30 days. The chart is the history of that r. Δr vs 60 days ago tells you if the relationship is strengthening or fading — Connect only shows isolated metrics.

explanations.title: Smoothed resting / min HR
explanations.text: Daily RHR jumps around. Weekly raw mean = short load response. 28d smooth = block fitness. 90d ≈ quarter. Half-year delta (first vs last 30d) is your long arrow. Yours: about −3.4 bpm.

explanations.title: Fitness–recovery gap
explanations.text: HRV first→last 30d: +10.4. Debt: +0.45 h/night. RHR: -3.4. Stronger engine, sleep account still overdrawn.

explanations.title: Capoeira tax by period
explanations.text: Each block = next-night sleep after Capoeira minus other days. Staying negative means class still costs sleep as fitness rises. Latest blocks near −0.2 to −0.8 h.

explanations.title: No-deload index
explanations.text: Steps on <6.5h nights minus ≥7h nights = 1191. Positive = busier when under-recovered — you need an explicit easy day rule.

explanations.title: Intensity → next debt
explanations.text: When this rolling r is positive, harder intensity weeks predict larger next-night shortfalls. Watch if it rises during Capoeira-heavy blocks.
